description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 62 - Order made to direct all manufacturers, importers, etc. to print the given information on each every bottle, pack or container of all edible oils w.e.f. 01.03.2017
reasoning: This gazette contains a Direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes new regulatory requirements (labeling information) for manufacturers, importers, distributors, and traders of edible oils. This content fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which include "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." Although a person's name (the Chairman) is present, it is in a signing capacity and the core content is purely regulatory, not about government personnel or structure.
